newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end off earlier lows following stocks' plunge.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end off earlier lows following stocks' plunge.

text.p: Key June Japanese government bond (JGB) futures ended Monday's Tokyo session down, but well off earlier lows as short-covering pressure intensified following an afternoon plunge in Tokyo stocks, traders said.
The June closed down 0.35 at 125.10 after falling as low as 124.63 in the morning. Turnover was 60,893 contracts.

The Nikkei 225 stock average ended down 589.34 points, or 3.16 percent, at an intraday low of 18,043.82 following a media report that Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka suggested that the consumption tax could be raised again in the future after a scheduled rise on April 1.
